display: SunFounder TS-7 7" HDMI touch display (1024 × 600 IPS)
mount: normal (IPS: no need to turn it upside down)

display_mount.screws: 4× M3 × 6 from behind, through the ears into the bezel's bosses
display_mount.cable_slot: 12 × 24 mm in the plate, 75.5-87.7 mm right of centre, 39-63 mm up: the HDMI flat cable and the micro-USB lead go through it into the pocket, then into the box through the slot above the USB window

viewer_frame.rule: every asm_*.stl: this frame moved by (-x, -y, -z_mid), then turned 180° about Y (PCB centre at the origin, its parts up)

pcb_constraints.outline: 100 × 100 mm, parts face the lid, 4× M3 on 92 × 92 into the posts
pcb_constraints.fan_zone: 32 × 32 mm centred at template [45.0, 46.0] (mm from the top-left, parts side up): parts ≤ 6 mm
pcb_constraints.sma_strip: 14 mm into the board × 12 mm along the edge, on the edge away from the Pi's ports, centred 34.5 mm below the board's top edge: no parts
pcb_constraints.corners: 10 × 10 mm round each mounting hole: no through-hole pins (posts and ribs underneath)

hardware.display_to_bezel: 4× M3 × 6 pan or button head, from behind through the display's ears
hardware.bezel_to_plate: 6× M3 × 10 from the back of the plate into 2.6 mm pilots
hardware.fan: 30 mm 5 V fan from the black Pi case, 4× M3 × 16 + nuts, blowing OUT through the lid
hardware.amps: 4× M4 nuts in the bottom bosses, M4 × 10 (RAM-B-202U round base, or a car bracket)
hardware.piezo: pressed into the 3 fingers on the bezel's skin (face on their 2 mm ledges), a dab of RTV on each; leads up the right cavity and out through the plate's slot
hardware.usb_wing: 3× M3 × 10 socket cap from inside the bezel's right cavity (before the display goes in), VHB on its back to the trim
hardware.usb_passthrough: 2× ALTW USB 3.0 passthroughs with their own hex nuts, tightened on the bench before the wing screws onto the bezel (the double-D flats stop them turning)

buzzer.part: 12 V active piezo Ø23.2 × 12 mm (MEASURE yours)
buzzer.where: in the bezel's right cavity below the display's plugs and the wing's bottom screw, centre [87.38, -32.0] mm (right of / above the bezel's centre), held by 3 fingers on the skin
buzzer.fires_through: 5 right intake slots (151 mm² open), 2.0 mm behind the bezel's skin
buzzer.wiring: J4 (BUZ) on the carrier: pin 3 + and pin 4 - only; the button pins 1-2 stay unused
buzzer.behaviour: blind-spot beeps auto-mute after 4 s (the side LED keeps flashing); a TPMS warning beeps twice, then only the screen shows it

usb_passthrough.hole: 2× Ø25.8 mm (v1 CFG.USB_HOLE_DIAMETER) × 23.8 mm double-D (measured 25.16 thread, 23.28 flats), in the wing's end wall
usb_passthrough.faces: the passenger side (+X), stacked vertically at Y = 43 and 4 mm (39 mm pitch)
usb_passthrough.cable: the lower cable climbs behind the centre screw post inside the wing; both cables enter the bezel through one side opening (hidden by the wing), cross above the display's plugs, and drop through the plate's cable slot into the pocket (car USB port + second USB / flush 12 V charger)
assembly: fit BOTH USB passthroughs into the wing on the bench first (double-D flats lock them; tighten the nuts with two flats level so they clear the trim, or from outside if rear-mounted)
bezel face down: feed both plugs through the bezel's side opening (one after the other) and screw the wing on with 3× M3 × 10 from inside the right cavity
fit the piezo and the display, then thread BOTH USB plugs through the plate's cable slot FIRST (one after the other), before the display's leads and piezo wires
measure: thread Ø 25.16 mm and double-D flats 23.28 mm (already measured from your caliper photos)
collar / front flange Ø and thickness (or confirm rear-mounted with front nut)
socket body Ø and how far it stands out
body/boot length behind the panel up to where the cable leaves
nut across corners / flats and thickness
the male plug's moulding (w × t × length)
free flat trim right of the bezel's edge (≥ wing size) and anything in front of it
